prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, spotlight stage redesign, photo quality callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, background readiness hints, and wait-time progress tip carousels.
Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts and flexibility copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress led to significant losses.
No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence flows and subsequent sign-in reorderings, diagnostic/archetype flows, waiting overlays/time indicators, visibility prompts, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path selection screens, custom pet style selectors, background readiness hints, and pre-upload style inspection views.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Companion Launch Welcome Layout: Replaces the home_intro welcome layout with an immersive full-bleed presentation showing the companion ready on the desktop workspace. (why: The finish step suffers from a sharp drop-off (64.8% completion, mean 5815s); a full-bleed visual layout creates an impactful arrival moment.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Selection Grid Layout: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a compact grid layout with immediate preview components. (why: Adoption step has high median duration (89s); a compact layout speeds up photo upload choices.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Activation Action Spotlight View: Introduces a spotlight component focus on the final welcome screen highlighting the exact desktop spawn button. (why: Support mail indicates user confusion around opening or placing the pet on desktop after setup (3 emails) and low finish rate (64.8%).)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Setup Progress Checklist: Adds a real-time environment checklist to the waiting screen displaying key background rendering milestones. (why: Home waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s; structured setup milestones keep users informed while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Compact Split Authentication View: Reconfigures the sign_in screen to use a split layout separating quick guest continuation from cloud account login. (why: 21.7% of users drop off at sign_in; clear split options reduce hesitation.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Minimalist Path Selection Headline Copy: Simplifies the headline and body text on the path selection screen to communicate quick setup speed. (why: 16.5% drop-off at choose_path; concise messaging lowers friction.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Sound Cue Switch: Enables an optional audio cue toggle component on the waiting screen when background generation completes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s; sound cues notify users multi-tasking away from the app when setup finishes.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Reset Safeguard Hint: Adds explicit hint copy on the sign_in screen explaining that logging into an existing account recovers existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after re-authenticating.)
